examples.question: Paid active ARR for accounts with usage down at least 30% and an open high/urgent ticket.
examples.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(arr), 0) AS at_risk_arr
FROM (
WITH paid_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
  FROM billing.subscriptions
  WHERE status = 'active' AND mrr > 0
  GROUP BY account_id
), usage_by_account AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'previous' THEN active_users ELSE 0 END) AS previous_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN active_users ELSE 0 END) AS current_users,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'previous' THEN active_users END) AS previous_observations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN active_users END) AS current_observations
  FROM product.usage
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT p.account_id, p.arr
FROM paid_accounts p
JOIN usage_by_account u ON u.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE u.previous_users > 0
  AND u.previous_observations > 0 AND u.current_observations > 0
  AND u.current_users <= u.previous_users * 0.7
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM support.tickets t
    WHERE t.account_id = p.account_id
      AND t.status = 'open' AND t.priority IN ('high', 'urgent')
  )
) AS risk_accounts

exclusions: Exclude missing usage periods or non-positive previous usage.
Exclude declines below 30% or accounts without an open high/urgent ticket.
Do not multiply ARR by ticket or usage row counts.
definition.grain: One account after subscription and usage aggregation.
definition.population: Paid active ARR for accounts with usage down at least 30% and an open high/urgent ticket.

metrics.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(arr), 0) AS at_risk_arr
FROM (
WITH paid_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
  FROM billing.subscriptions
  WHERE status = 'active' AND mrr > 0
  GROUP BY account_id
), usage_by_account AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'previous' THEN active_users ELSE 0 END) AS previous_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN active_users ELSE 0 END) AS current_users,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'previous' THEN active_users END) AS previous_observations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN active_users END) AS current_observations
  FROM product.usage
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT p.account_id, p.arr
FROM paid_accounts p
JOIN usage_by_account u ON u.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE u.previous_users > 0
  AND u.previous_observations > 0 AND u.current_observations > 0
  AND u.current_users <= u.previous_users * 0.7
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM support.tickets t
    WHERE t.account_id = p.account_id
      AND t.status = 'open' AND t.priority IN ('high', 'urgent')
  )
) AS risk_accounts
